tasks.label: Build OCS2 mobile manipulator
args: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && export CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=$PWD/third_party/ros/opt/ros/humble:$CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH && export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$PWD/third_party/ros/opt/ros/humble/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH && colcon build --packages-up-to ocs2_mobile_manipulator_ros --symlink-install
